title: Training Questions and Answers: Final-Month Renewal Credit on the All-Inclusive Utility Package Fee
content:
# Final-Month Renewal Credit — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

**Rule.** A final-month renewal credit is subtracted from the final package fee of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account: **$5.00** when the lease has at least 3 renewal rent changes on record, **$2.50** when it has at least 1 but fewer than 3, and **$0.00** otherwise. It is subtracted as well as any other credit on the line, and the line's amount never falls below zero.

## Questions answered

**Which rent changes count?** The rent changes recorded with the reason renewal on the Lease Term Agreement records of the lease.

**A lease renewed twice?** At least 1 but fewer than 3: $2.50.

**A lease renewed three times?** At least 3: $5.00.

**A lease never renewed?** $0.00.

**Can the credit take the line below zero?** No; the line's amount never falls below zero.

*Worked case (hypothetical reduced fee of $4.10, three renewals):* $4.10 less $5.00 would be negative, so the line's amount is $0.00.
